# Power failure and site outage at S-SFX-002

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** power_failure at `S-SFX-002`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarms and metrics trace mains failure, battery low, site down, and recovery on S-SFX-002.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-09 15:15 to 2026-09-09 17:30
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-09 13:15
- **Affected:** S-SFX-002

## Summary

AC mains power failure led to battery exhaustion and subsequent site down state.

Traffic, active users and availability dropped on site S-SFX-002 for 2 hours.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-09 13:15: Major MAINS_FAILURE raised on S-SFX-002. [ALM-000130]
- 2026-09-09 15:07: Major BATTERY_LOW raised on S-SFX-002. [ALM-000132]

- 2026-09-09 15:22: Critical SITE_DOWN raised on S-SFX-002. [ALM-000134]
- 2026-09-09 17:29: All alarms cleared on S-SFX-002 as power was restored. [ALM-000130, ALM-000132, ALM-000134]
- 2026-09-09 17:30: Alert ended for S-SFX-002. [ALR-0009]

## Evidence

- Traffic, active users and availability dropped on site S-SFX-002 for 2 hours. [ALR-0009]
- MAINS_FAILURE occurred on S-SFX-002 at 13:15. [ALM-000130]
- BATTERY_LOW triggered on S-SFX-002 at 15:07. [ALM-000132]
- SITE_DOWN triggered on S-SFX-002 at 15:22. [ALM-000134]
- No changes occurred on S-SFX-002 and its parents between 2026-09-09 14:00 and 19:00. [T3]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on S-SFX-002 and its parents between 2026-09-09 14:00 and 19:00. [T4]

## Hypotheses

1. **power_failure** at S-SFX-002: confirmed. Mains failure, battery low, and site down alarms precisely match the traffic and availability outage timeline. [ALM-000130, ALM-000132, ALM-000134, ALR-0009]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-SFX-02-B: rejected. No alarms were found on the transport link LNK-SFX-02-B or aggregate router AGG-SFX-02 during the window. [T7]

## Ruled out

- T3: No changes were recorded on S-SFX-002 and its parents during the incident window.

- T6: No alarms were present on the sibling site S-SFX-001.

- T8: Sibling site S-SFX-001 showed no KPI deviations during the incident window.

- Inspect the local power feed and mains supply at site S-SFX-002.
- Verify battery backup health and autonomy duration at site S-SFX-002.

confounders.why: Harmless parameter_tuning on S-SFX-002 86 min before the mains failure; the site went down hours later, when the batteries ran out, and neighbours with the same change were unaffected.

truth.notes: trap=change_on_root_node; Mains failure at S-SFX-002; the batteries lasted 2.1 h, so the KPIs stayed normal until they were exhausted. Trap: a parameter change on S-SFX-002 itself ran 86 min before the mains failure, so a hasty investigator blames it for the site going down. Settled by: (1) MAINS_FAILURE (major) and later BATTERY_LOW precede the SITE_DOWN, which is the power sequence, and a parameter change cannot cut the mains; (2) the KPIs were normal for hours after the change; (3) the same tuning went onto S-SFX-001 under the same ticket and they stayed up.
